name: HelloBench
abstract: HelloBench evaluates long-form text generation. This page uses AVG S from the paper's main experiment table.
contributions: The benchmark targets long-form quality rather than sheer output length.
This page uses AVG S to avoid fragmenting the main leaderboard into too many partial attributes.
method: HelloBench focuses on long-form generation rather than the more common long-context understanding setting.
It organizes tasks into five categories based on Bloom's Taxonomy, including QA, summarization, chat, completion, and heuristic generation.
The paper also proposes HelloEval as a more efficient human-aligned evaluation method for long text quality.
Large-scale experiments show that current models face length ceilings, repetition, and clear quality degradation.
The benchmark highlights that generating longer text and generating better long text are not the same ability.
leaderboard_note: The leaderboard uses AVG S from the main experiments table. The paper also analyzes other dimensions and word-count behavior, which are not used as the main leaderboard here.
